thread:
Maya: Heads-up — thinking about the autofallback switchover UX. We need clear paging vs console-only notifications and an auditable path that shows WHY we fell back. Quick opinions?
Liam: +1. SRE care here. Do we send PagerDuty for soft-degrades or only for full failovers? We should gate by SLA impact.
Ingrid: Proposal: PD when error_rate >= 3x baseline OR latency > SLO for > 2m. Otherwise: console banner + email digest. Also add an "audit link" that expands to the exact policy evaluation that matched.
Sam: How would the "audit link" work in practice? Maybe short id + a "replay decision" button that runs in a sandbox with recorded metrics.
Maya: Exactly — minimal UI: policy match card with a tiny timeline and actions (acknowledge, escalate, replay). Sketch of the policy payload we want attached:
```json
{
  "policy_id": "pf-2026-03",
  "trigger": "5xx_rate > 1% for 30s",
  "mode": "soft-degrade",
  "notify": ["console", "email"],
  "operator_escalate": true
}
```
Liam: If `operator_escalate` is true that implies PD. For soft-degrade default should be false — we don't want PD for noisy transient spikes.
Ingrid: Also we need an immutable audit blob stored with the event: inputs (route, model, region), policy_snapshot, matching_metrics window, and operator_actions. That blob must be exportable for postmortem.
Sam: +1. Add an operator_notes field so humans can attach rationale. Makes root-cause followups easier.
deploy-bot: Deployment finished: infra/rollouts v2.1.4 at 2026-03-12T15:22Z. No active incidents.
Maya: UX question: timeline — should the console show "policy matched" then "operator confirmed" inline, or separate the audit into a collapsible panel?
Liam: Inline events are better. Context should live next to the decision so on-call doesn't have to chase multiple pages.
Ingrid: Replay must run against the recorded metrics window (snapshot), not live traffic. We need a readonly sandbox that will not affect production.
Sam: Gate replay to a role (replay.operator) so only authorized folks can trigger historical re-eval.
Maya: Ok I'll make a mockup: compact timeline entry + right-side audit panel with JSON and a small list of actions (replay, export, annotate).
Liam: Can I own PD gating? I'll draft default thresholds and an escalation matrix by EOD.
Ingrid: I'll draft the audit schema and storage TTL options tomorrow.
Sam: I'll file an RBAC ticket for the replay permission and a short acceptance criteria doc.
Maya: Thanks all — leaving this here. We'll iterate the mockup in Figma and sync next week. :thumbsup:
